- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — model tends to overshoot early in upward trends.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (negative sentiment < -0.30) — model fails to capture sharp drops or mean reversion.
- Lag in price corrections: model often delays downward revisions after sentiment shifts to negative, especially after spikes.
- Overshoot after spikes: model frequently peaks too high after a sharp price rise, then undercorrects.
- Mean reversion bias: model overestimates long-term mean in volatile periods, especially when sentiment is mixed or neutral.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts are overly optimistic in early cycles (e.g., 2024-11-14) and overly pessimistic in late cycles (e.g., 2024-09-24) — adjust for sentiment momentum decay.
